name: LiteSpeed Cache
notes: Sets LiteSpeed Cache up to do, with SEO Pro Stack, what WP-Optimize does on LiteSpeed hosting. LiteSpeed Cache keeps pages, browser caching and CSS and JS; SEO Pro Stack does images, Heartbeat, WordPress extras and script delay. Every site: notifications off (news and promotions fetched from LiteSpeed's servers), CSS and JS minified (not combined: with HTTP/2 combining saves little and breaks more), and the whole cache purged when plugins or themes update, so pages never point at old CSS and JS. On a LiteSpeed server, SEO Pro Stack also turns the page cache and browser cache on; elsewhere it leaves them alone, because the page cache needs the server. Where an SEO Pro Stack feature does a job, LiteSpeed's copy is turned off, so the two never both do it: Load JS Deferred with Delay scripts until people interact, Next-Gen Image Format with WebP and AVIF copies, Heartbeat control with Fewer Heartbeat requests (site and admin screens; editors are left alone), and Remove WordPress Emoji with Remove WordPress extras. Nothing that needs QUIC.cloud is turned on (critical and unused CSS, image optimisation, the crawler), and the object cache is left to the host. Applying saves through LiteSpeed Cache's own code, so its .htaccess rules, WP_CACHE line and purges follow. On multisite only the settings for every site apply: LiteSpeed Cache keeps most settings for the whole network there.

litespeed.conf.news.label: Notifications
litespeed.conf.news.description: Shows LiteSpeed news in the admin: hotfixes, new releases, beta versions and promotions.

litespeed.conf.optm-css_min.label: CSS Minify
litespeed.conf.optm-css_min.description: Minify CSS files and inline CSS code.

litespeed.conf.optm-js_min.label: JS Minify
litespeed.conf.optm-js_min.description: Minify JS files and inline JS codes.

litespeed.conf.purge-upgrade.label: Purge All On Upgrade
litespeed.conf.purge-upgrade.description: Purges the whole cache when a plugin, theme or WordPress core is upgraded.

litespeed.conf.cache.label: Enable Cache
litespeed.conf.cache.description: The page cache, kept by the LiteSpeed server. Set on LiteSpeed servers only.

litespeed.conf.cache-browser.label: Browser Cache
litespeed.conf.cache-browser.description: Lets browsers keep static files such as images, CSS and JS. Set on LiteSpeed servers only.

litespeed.conf.optm-js_defer.label: Load JS Deferred
litespeed.conf.optm-js_defer.description: Defers or delays JS. Turned off while SEO Pro Stack's Delay scripts until people interact is on.

litespeed.conf.img_optm-webp.label: Next-Gen Image Format
litespeed.conf.img_optm-webp.description: Serves WebP or AVIF copies made by QUIC.cloud. Turned off while SEO Pro Stack's WebP and AVIF copies are on.

litespeed.conf.misc-heartbeat_front.label: Frontend Heartbeat Control
litespeed.conf.misc-heartbeat_front.description: LiteSpeed's Heartbeat timing on the site. Turned off while SEO Pro Stack's Fewer Heartbeat requests limits it there.

litespeed.conf.misc-heartbeat_back.label: Backend Heartbeat Control
litespeed.conf.misc-heartbeat_back.description: LiteSpeed's Heartbeat timing on admin screens. Turned off while SEO Pro Stack's Fewer Heartbeat requests limits it there.

litespeed.conf.optm-emoji_rm.label: Remove WordPress Emoji
litespeed.conf.optm-emoji_rm.description: Stops the WordPress emoji script. Turned off while SEO Pro Stack's Remove WordPress extras removes it.
